realm.name: viewer
realm.description: Read the box: browse files, search their contents, download bytes, and read the config a service declares. Gates 3 routers (portal-files read + download, bothy-config read).

realm.name: editor
realm.description: Change a file on disk, and patch a declared config field. Saves write straight to the working tree. Gates 3 routers (portal-files write + delete, bothy-config patch).

realm.name: operator
realm.description: Act on what is running - restart, stop and start a service. Gates 3 routers, one per verb (bothy-control). There is no exec and no kill.

realm.name: shell
realm.description: HIGH PRIVILEGE: arbitrary terminal. Keep composite=false and never nest it in another role. Step-up re-auth: see auth/compose.yml.

clients.name: oauth2-proxy (Traefik forwardAuth)
clients.description: The only OIDC client here. Traefik asks oauth2-proxy for a verdict; it asks Keycloak. Secret and redirect URI are injected from .env at import.
